results.title: Tycho! Beyond the Baton
results.overview: A Hungarian child music prodigy survives the Holocaust, finds peace in Australia and for more than 50 years makes an extraordinary contribution to its culture.

results.title: Dark Side Of Night
results.overview: A successful prosecutor takes his family to their vacation home. After a home invasion leaves him shot, his wife and daughter escape into the forest where they are pursued by the men who invaded their home. Estranged mother and daughter must work together or die. Will they survive?

results.title: Dans la peau de McWalter
results.overview: Staged behind the scenes look at the McWalter movie.

results.title: The Fisherman
results.overview: A Prize-Winning Fisherman sets out to catch a Mermaid, and prove his skeptical wife wrong.

results.title: For the Sake of a 50!
results.overview: On this summer day in 1977, Léon and Eugénie are preparing to welcome their entire family into their small house. It's their grandson Stéphane's birthday, but it's mostly a pretext to gather with the patriarch, weakened by illness. But what appears to be a routine family reunion will highlight everyone's tensions and resentment. It reaches a point of no return.

results.title: Deal!
results.overview: Chốt Đơn! follows the bustling lives of Hoàng Linh, a young and successful “chốt đơn warrior,” and Chú An (Quyền Linh), an office worker who also moonlights as a rideshare driver. Amid societal pressures, uncertainties, and changes impacting two generations, Hoàng Linh and Chú An, despite their differences in age, background, and personality, discover a pure friendship. Together, they ignite new passions, leading to victorious “Chốt Đơn!” sessions.

results.title: Complô
results.overview: Orphan of the country where he was born, orphan of the Portuguese state. Imprisoned for half his life, never free. Bruno is ‘Ghoya’, a Cape Verdean Creole rapper and political activist. This film is a crossroads in a moment of struggle and life.

results.title: Idris Elba: Our Knife Crime Crisis
results.original_title: Idris Elba: Our Knife Crime Crisis
results.overview: Idris Elba confronts the reality of knife crime, speaking to those most affected - from the streets to the system - in a quest to uncover how we can break the cycle.

results.title: Inday Opil Goes to Heaven
results.overview: Inday Opil navigates the afterlife, eager to reach heaven. She must first embark on a journey untangling the weave of fate to be where she is meant to be.

results.title: BitterSweet
results.overview: Sam, a new father with undiagnosed neurodivergence, faces a bureaucratic nightmare after a mix-up leads to his arrest, separating him from his family. With humor and heart, BitterSweet tackles toxic masculinity, parenthood, and injustice.

results.title: Static
results.overview: An emergency broadcast plays on the cusp of war, but The President only addresses one person.

results.title: Leshy
results.overview: When her friend goes missing in the woods, Marcia goes searching for her only to come to the horrifying realisation that she is not alone in these woods.

results.title: A Blackbird Sat on a Branch
results.overview: A young man finds himself on a wide open field. He watches a group of people working hard to find something in this wasteland. But is what he sees true, or at least real? Then, the next thought floods his mind and he is taken by it. A memory of his father. The track through his memory leads him to an emotional day with his father, back then. Until the story begins to suffocate him and his younger self determines to escape, eventually landing at a familiar wide open field. Now the past and the present are intertwined and reality molts into a new and fantastic perspective.

results.title: Embodied
results.overview: Refusing to submit to the image of an overlooked old woman TONA bares all to the gazing eyes of a life drawing class.

results.title: Valley of Dreams
results.overview: Their art and way of life are a mirage of elusive beauty. Here, the legendary past shares a roof with the everyday present. On the verandas of old dachas, samovars still emit their smoke, while through the mist rising from the ravines, it seems as if eyes from the past are peering into our world.  And we will follow that gaze—into the workshop of toy-making master Viktor Nazariti, into the village house of artist Maria Dreznina, into the old home of Yuri Macheret and Marina Faidysh, once bought from the Polenovs, into the garden of Irina Starzhenetskaya and Anatoliy Komelin.  The artistic dynasties of the Vatagins, Bragovskiys, and Birshteins will open their doors, pouring the energy of creativity onto their canvases, joining us in gazing into the mist rising from the ravines—wondering if, for a fleeting moment, eyes from the past will appear within it.

results.title: Road's End in Taiwan
results.overview: Damien grew up in Geneva, never knowing his father. At thirty-two, he suddenly learns that he is the direct heir of an Englishman living in Taiwan. Damien flies to Taipei where he meets his Taiwanese half-brother Steven. Their inheritance is suspended, on account of two other missing heirs. Damien and Steven set out to find them on the island.
